Initial release of industry-evolution-3d: interactive 3D industry evolution maps

- Generates a 3D interactive industry/technology/person evolution timeline map using world map, true geolocations, and vertical time axis.
- Supports person, product, and event nodes with year, location, type, and details; customizable with avatar/logo images.
- Node hover displays floating detail cards, pinned visually above all.
- Interactive: rotate, zoom, explore by geography and year.
- Easy deployment: one-command HTML generation from a user-provided JSON list—no web coding required.
- Tightly parameterized for reuse across domains; works with or without a base map.
